//: DEMON TELLS (docs/PLAN_demons.md D3; game/demon_seals.h TellFor). What a contained demon lets slip about how well it is held. MARGIN = circle strength - demon power - contract weight (0 until D5). A band speaks while margin >= its minMargin; below every band the lowest one speaks. Lines are picked by rng::Hash3, so the same tick says the same thing. Data only in D3; D5's conversation speaks them.

lines: You have done this before. Pity.
The salt is thick. I will wait.
Ask, then. Quickly.
Your ring is adequate. Adequate.
I have stood in worse circles. Not many.
Careful. Your salt is thin on the north side.
One candle fewer and we would be having a different talk.
Go on. Let me out. I promise to be good.
Oh, this ring? This ring is a suggestion.
Release me. I insist.
Ha! You drew this with your foot.
Open the circle, little summoner. Let us meet properly.
Skerrick is good. Skerrick is very good. Look how good.
So much sulfur. You must not like Skerrick.
What does the big one want? Skerrick fetches. Skerrick carries.
Nice ring. Nice ring. Skerrick hates it.
Your candle is guttering, master. Just saying.
Skerrick could stand a little to the left. Just a little.
Hee. Hee hee. Let Skerrick out, master. Skerrick will be quick.
That is not a ring. That is a smudge.
